mapper.select: SELECT id, year, description, sortOrder, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM companyhistory ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, createdAt ASC
SELECT id, year, description, sortOrder, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM companyhistory WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO companyhistory (id, year, description, sortOrder, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES (#{id}, #{year}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE companyhistory SET year=#{year}, description=#{description}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE companyhistory SET sortOrder=#{sortOrder}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
